title: Ops Manual Section Swap
question:
# Task: Reorganize Operations Manual Page Sections
## Objective Modify the structure of the Operations Manual page in Notion by reorganizing sections through swapping and replacing the usual column layout step with a support FAQ cleanup.
## Requirements
### Step 1: Swap Sections - Navigate to the Operations Manual page. - Swap the positions of the "Escalation Rules" and "Response Standards"
  sections.
- Preserve all content within each section exactly as is. - Maintain the original formatting and structure of each section.
### Step 2: Reorganize the Support FAQ Toggle 1. Add a column list with two columns inside the Support FAQ toggle. 2. Move the first two existing Q&A pairs from the FAQ to the left column. 3. Move the third existing Q&A pair to the right column. 4. Add one additional Q&A pair in the right column to match the format, so
   both columns have exactly 2 Q&A pairs.
5. Ensure all Q&A pairs maintain consistent formatting (heading_3 for
   questions, paragraph for answers).
